_.coverage: ACT street localities with at least one address, plus all streets of 11 NSW localities: Queanbeyan, Queanbeyan East, Queanbeyan West, Karabar, Crestwood, Greenleigh, The Ridgeway, Jerrabomberra, Googong, Tralee, Royalla. House numbers are not included and are never verified.
_.format: localities: [name, state, postcode]; streets: [streetName, streetTypeAbbreviation, localityIndex, postcode?] (postcode only when it differs from the locality's)
